asr.full_text: Grow your Bitcoin with MiroTrading International Introducing MiroTrading International MiroTrading International PTY LTD is a registered company in the Republic of South Africa. The registered office is situated at 341 Baers Nordea Drive in Northcliffe. Johan Steenbreg is a CEO and founder from Polakwana in South Africa. The objective of Mirror Trading International is to grow your Bitcoin. Your balance in trade is always in Bitcoin and you earn Bitcoin daily. When the price of Bitcoin rises, the value of your trading account will go up. The profitability of Mirror Trading International comes solely from the trading activities. Your full investment goes into your trading account. Mirror Trading International provides you with a passive income opportunity. Earn passively from daily trading which takes place from Monday to Friday. The trade results are not guaranteed. No trading knowledge is required. To get started you will need a Bitcoin wallet, to register with Mirro Trading International and and $100 in Bitcoin which is the suggested minimum You will need to fund your account within 7 days Accounts not funded will be deleted from the system after 7 days In MirroTrading International there are no membership fees no subscriptions, no packages no costs and no deductions. Your full bitcoin payment goes to your Trading Account. There are no contracts or lockdowns. You can withdraw in full or partial amounts, and you can withdraw whenever you like. There are no withdrawal fees, or penalties. Withdrawal Request will be sent to your bitcoin wallet within 48 hours, as long as it is not over a weekend, cos then it might take a bit longer. Profits from successful daily trades are divided and allocated as follows . 10% to Mirror Trading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses 20% to the binary profit sharing bonuses All income is subject to positive daily trading results The system is fully automated and you can sit back and relax and receive your daily statements, detailing the income from the trades for the day. Your daily trade income is automatically compounded. Members are not permitted their own broker accounts as per the terms of the software licence agreement. Your account remains active provided you maintain a minimum balance in trade. The suggested amount is 100 in bitcoin. Providing you with a passive sustainable income from your Bitcoin and trade is at the very heart of Meritrading International that summarizes the passive part of the opportunity and as a member you will earn from the daily trading activities and grow your Bitcoin Meritrading International has an optional affiliate program, Should you wish to refer your friends or new members. The binary structure works as follows. You can recruit new members into your left or right leg. To qualify for binary bonuses, you'll also need a minimum amount of $200 in the trading pool and you will need to have personally recruited one new member in your left and one in your right leg. The third person you personally introduce will become spillover for one of the people you introduced before as you can only place in your left or right side. Spillover will also occur if your sponsor or team members above you introduce people into a leg. 20 percent of the income from the week's trading will be shared according to the Bitcoin value of your weaker leg. When you are binary qualified with $200-$999 in your personal account, this will allow you to earn up to 10 levels in the binary. textual.observation: The presentation describes a passive Bitcoin income opportunity, says participants earn Bitcoin from daily trading, and asks them to register, have a Bitcoin wallet, and fund an account with a suggested minimum of $100 in Bitcoin within 7 days.

evidence.quote: Mirror Trading International provides you with a passive income opportunity. Earn passively from daily trading which takes place from Monday to Friday.

To get started you will need a Bitcoin wallet, to register with Mirro Trading International and and $100 in Bitcoin which is the suggested minimum You will need to fund your account within 7 days Accounts not funded will be deleted from the system after 7 days

textual.context: Presented as an investment/trading opportunity by the speaker; the supplied source does not independently establish the stated trading activity, company details, or outcomes.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed passive daily Bitcoin return is directly linked to registering, maintaining a Bitcoin wallet, and funding an account by a stated deadline.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether an account was funded, whether Bitcoin was transferred, who controls any wallet, or whether the claimed returns occur.

textual.observation: The presentation offers referral and binary profit-sharing bonuses tied to introducing members, maintaining a stated Bitcoin balance, and recruiting one person into each side of a binary structure.

evidence.quote: Mirotrading International offers two types of affiliate rewards Ten Percent Direct Referral Bonus or Twenty Percent Weekly Profit Sharing Bonus
you will earn a 10 referral bonus for every member you personally introduce to mirror trading international and also for any amounts they add over and above their original investment
To qualify for binary bonuses, you'll also need a minimum amount of $200 in the trading pool and you will need to have personally recruited one new member in your left and one in your right leg.

textual.context: Presented as an optional affiliate program and residual-income opportunity; the source attributes bonuses to daily trading income.
textual.potential_relevance: The stated bonus claims are linked to both recruitment of new members and account-funding conditions, including a $200 trading-pool minimum for binary bonuses.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that referral payments, profit-sharing payments, or recruited members' deposits occurred, or that the bonus structure operates as described.

visual.observation: Slides branded "Mirror Trading International" state that the objective is to "GROW YOUR BITCOIN," that a full investment/Bitcoin payment goes into a trading account or trade, and show a historical daily trading-income allocation including "Members 40%."
visual.context: Promotional presentation. The allocation slide visibly states, "Historical results are no guarantee of future results."
visual.potential_relevance: The visible return/income claims are connected to viewers funding a Bitcoin investment or payment for trading under the displayed organization branding.
visual.limitations: The samples do not show account enrollment, an actual transfer, a recipient wallet, transaction results, or whether the stated trading and allocation claims are accurate.

visual.observation: Slides describe an optional affiliate program, a "10% Direct Referral Bonuses" offer limited to members who have funded accounts, a left/right-leg "spillover" structure, and more earning levels tied to increasing the amount in trade and team-member qualifications.
visual.context: Promotional presentation describing a referral and binary-level compensation structure; the final slide asks viewers to contact the person who referred them.
visual.potential_relevance: The displayed bonus and residual-income claims are linked to funding an account, referring new members, arranging placements in a two-leg structure, and meeting stated trade-amount/team-member conditions.
visual.limitations: The sampled slides do not show the full affiliate terms, actual recruiting activity, payments, participant outcomes, or any contact details beyond the instruction to contact a referrer.

textual_context_notes.observation: The presentation explicitly states that trade results are not guaranteed.

evidence.quote: The trade results are not guaranteed.

textual_context_notes.observation: The presentation qualifies income and bonuses as dependent on positive trading results.

evidence.quote: All income is subject to positive daily trading results
if they are no trading profits they can be no income or bonuses

visual_context_notes.observation: A slide qualifies the displayed daily trading-income figure with: "Historical results are no guarantee of future results."
A slide states that the affiliate program is optional, and another states that free members who have not funded accounts do not qualify for the displayed direct-referral bonus.
The levels slide visibly states that levels are subject to binary qualification and a required amount of team members in the weaker leg.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes passive Bitcoin trading income through registration, wallet setup, and funding an account with a suggested minimum of $100 within seven days. It also offers referral and binary bonuses tied to recruiting members, maintaining trading-pool funds, and increasing trade amounts, although it states that results are not guaranteed and does not establish that any transfers, trading, bonus payments, or participant outcomes occurred.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer is participation in a Bitcoin trading account using an initial Bitcoin contribution and promising passive income from daily trading, including automatic compounding. The presentation also promotes a binary recruitment structure in which team growth and multiple levels are linked to bonuses, supporting S06 as a secondary mechanism.

evidence.observation: The presentation describes the trading offer as providing a passive income opportunity.
evidence.quote: Mirror Trading International provides you with a passive income opportunity.

evidence.observation: The offer presents automated daily trading income and automatic compounding as a passive-return feature.

evidence.observation: Qualification for the binary structure requires a trading-pool amount and personal recruitment into both left and right legs.
evidence.quote: you'll also need a minimum amount of $200 in the trading pool and you will need to have personally recruited one new member in your left and one in your right leg

evidence.observation: The presentation links team growth and increased participation to eligibility for earnings on additional levels.
